usedFor: Box holds files and folders, and “New File” there can open a deal through “Create Deal” in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New File” in Box, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A file added to a folder is Box's clearest signal, and the action gives sales a deal to work from.

watchOut: Box triggers here are polling, so “New File” reaches HubSpot after a short delay.
